data.overview: An astronomer and five fellow scholars launch themselves toward the moon in a shell fired from an enormous cannon. On the strange lunar surface, their expedition becomes a fantastical scramble through caverns, curious creatures, and perils no earthly lecture could prepare them for.
data.tagline: A small step for dreamers, a giant leap into wonder.
data.title: The Cannon and the Moon
